body_markdown:
Apple's non-Pro iPhone usually gets modest, incremental updates. Not this year. The iPhone 17 picked up a genuinely bigger display, a 120Hz ProMotion screen (previously Pro-only), and a completely reworked front camera — the kind of jump that used to be reserved for the Pro line.

## What Apple Actually Said at the Keynote

Apple's pitch for the iPhone 17 centered on a new Center Stage front camera — the first square front camera sensor Apple has put on an iPhone. It offers a wider field of view and up to 18MP resolution, and crucially, it lets you shoot landscape photos and videos without rotating the phone: hold it vertically, and the camera automatically reframes for group shots by using AI to expand the field of view.

On the display, Apple's key claim was straightforward: a 6.3-inch Super Retina XDR display — its best ever on a non-Pro iPhone — now running at 120Hz ProMotion, a feature previously locked to Pro models. Apple also highlighted Ceramic Shield 2 across the front, offering 3x better scratch resistance than the previous generation, and a 33% reduction in screen reflections.

On cameras, the iPhone 17 gained a 48MP Fusion Main camera with an integrated optical-quality 2x Telephoto, plus a new 48MP Fusion Ultra Wide camera capturing up to 4x the resolution of the previous generation.

## Colors and Finishes

The iPhone 17 comes in five colors, the widest color range in this year's lineup:

- **Lavender** — the boldest of the five, and the color Apple itself used to showcase the phone.
- **Sage** — an earthy green tone, bolder than Mist Blue but still fairly neutral.
- **Mist Blue** — a cool, relaxed option for buyers who want something different from black or white without going bold.
- **Black** — the classic, safe choice.
- **White** — clean and versatile.

## Why This Generation Actually Matters

- **120Hz ProMotion, no longer Pro-exclusive** — smoother scrolling and animations on a non-Pro iPhone for the first time.
- **New Center Stage front camera** — genuinely new functionality, not just a resolution bump: automatic reframing for group selfies without rotating the phone.
- **48MP Ultra Wide, new this generation** — up to 4x the resolution of the previous iPhone 17 generation's ultra-wide camera.
- **Ceramic Shield 2** — 3x better scratch resistance and meaningfully reduced glare outdoors.
- **A19 chip** — the same chip family powering Apple Intelligence features like Live Translation and Image Playground.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is the iPhone 17 price in Kenya?**

**Does the iPhone 17 have a 120Hz display?**
Yes — this is the first standard (non-Pro) iPhone to get ProMotion's 120Hz refresh rate.

**How is the front camera different this year?**
The iPhone 17 introduces a new square-sensor Center Stage front camera that can automatically reframe for group shots and let you shoot landscape photos while holding the phone vertically.

**Is the iPhone 17 water resistant?**
Yes, IP68 rated for dust and water resistance.

**Is the iPhone 17 worth it over the iPhone 17 Pro?**
If you don't need the Pro's telephoto zoom or vapor chamber cooling for sustained heavy workloads, the standard iPhone 17 now covers nearly everything most people actually use day to day, at a significantly lower price.

## The Bottom Line

The iPhone 17 closed more of the gap to the Pro line than any standard iPhone in recent memory — a 120Hz display, a genuinely new front camera, and a sharper ultra-wide lens. For most everyday users, this is the iPhone that makes the most sense.
